segments.sn29.6:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn29.6:1.3: “ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yena midhekacce opapātikā nāgā uposathaṃ upavasanti vossaṭṭhakāyā ca bhavantī”ti?
segments.sn29.6:2.1: “Idha, bhikkhu, ekaccānaṃ opapātikānaṃ nāgānaṃ evaṃ hoti –
segments.sn29.6:2.2: ‘mayaṃ kho pubbe kāyena dvayakārino ahumha, vācāya dvayakārino, manasā dvayakārino.
segments.sn29.6:2.3: Te mayaṃ kāyena dvayakārino, vācāya dvayakārino, manasā dvayakārino, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā opapātikānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapannā.
segments.sn29.6:2.4: Sacajja mayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ careyyāma, vācāya… manasā sucaritaṃ careyyāma, evaṃ mayaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyāma.
segments.sn29.6:2.5: Handa, mayaṃ etarahi kāyena sucaritaṃ carāma, vācāya… manasā sucaritaṃ carāmā’ti.
segments.sn29.6:2.6: Ayaṃ kho, bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yena midhekacce opapātikā nāgā uposathaṃ upavasanti vossaṭṭhakāyā ca bhavantī”ti.

lines: Tatrassa akusalaṃ upapattiyā paccayo hoti, kusalaṃ upapannānaṃ sampattiyā.
Tesañhi dīghāyukatāya ca vaṇṇavantatāya ca sukhabahulatāya ca patthanaṃ katvā imaṃ dasavidhaṃ dānavatthuṃ datvā taṃ sampattiṃ anubhavituṃ tattha nibbattanti.
Vissaṭṭhakāyāti “ye cammena vā rudhirena vā aṭṭhinā vā atthikā, te sabbaṃ gaṇhantū”ti tattha nirapekkhacittatāya adhiṭṭhitasīlatāya pariccattasarīrā.
Patthanaṃ katvā…pe… tattha nibbattanti campeyyanāgarājā viyāti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
